subject.title: fix(google): bound SSE stream body reads at 16 MiB

question: Should Google and Vertex SSE success bodies fail closed once the streamed body exceeds 16 MiB?
rationale: The cap matches sibling provider safety ceilings, but it changes behavior for any existing oversized Google or Vertex stream and green CI cannot prove that upgrade impact is acceptable.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling after proof
options.body: Require redacted runtime or live-output proof, then land the PR with the same 16 MiB safety ceiling used by sibling stream readers.

options.title: Hold for a shared or configurable policy
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want a different shared SDK guard, threshold policy, or compatibility strategy before changing Google stream behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted runtime or live-output proof, then land the PR with the same 16 MiB safety ceiling used by sibling stream readers.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently merged adjacent Google transport work and is the clearest routing candidate for accepting the compatibility tradeoff.
